name: 0 Days Without
look: A still from The Simpsons. Lenny, with dark swept-back hair and a green shirt, stands at a big sign reading '0 DAYS WITHOUT' followed by a blank space, swapping out a '0' number card for another '0' card.
use: Mocks something that keeps happening again and again. The blank on the sign is filled with the thing that just happened yet again, so the counter resets to zero before it can ever go up.
slots: blank after 'DAYS WITHOUT' on the sign: the thing that keeps happening
label on Lenny (optional): who keeps resetting it
examples: someone hitting reply-all to the whole company
describe: simpsons sign that says zero days without
lenny changing the number on a days without sign
guy flipping a 0 to another 0 on a safety counter
cartoon worker resetting the accident counter back to zero
simpsons days since last accident sign reset
origin: An edited still from The Simpsons of Lenny changing the number on a workplace safety sign.
